==Description==
'''Rift Walker Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 34 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{GumDrops|975}} or {{Robux|107}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|15,025}} or {{Robux|2,486}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|134}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Robux|3,123}}.

==Appearance==
'''Rift Walker Charm''' appearance is based on [[Rift Walker]]. It has [[Rift Walker]] standing on a platform with a few spikes coming out of it. It is holding up its staff, using it to cast a spell. Black and purple smoke comes out of the charm.

The color of '''Rift Walker Charm''' depends on the username color of the player in the chat, though it is purple in its inventory preview.
